'''The Circle''' was a circular building located in the center of the [[Western Ice Shelf]] area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOR" /> During the events that followed the return of the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' on Ilum during the [[Galactic War]], the Circle saw heavy fighting between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="TOR:RotG">{{TORcite|Event: "Relics of the Gree"}}</ref>
